title: tianma-if/edgeever: notes you host, with an MCP door
friendlyTitle: EdgeEver: notes you host, with a door for agents
summary: EdgeEver gained 12 stars on GitHub's TypeScript trending list today, and has about 3,500. The project describes it as an AI-native note app, with sync, a web clipper, and MCP, that you can run on Cloudflare or Docker. The license is AGPL-3.0.
friendlySummary: EdgeEver gained 12 stars on GitHub's TypeScript trending list today, and has about 3,500. The project describes it as an AI note app, with sync, a web clipper, and MCP, that you can run on Cloudflare or Docker. The license is AGPL-3.0.
whyItMatters: You can keep notes on a server you run and let an agent reach them through MCP, instead of pasting the notebook into a hosted chat. AGPL-3.0 can require you to share your changes if you offer the app as a network service. A clipper is not a private vault by itself.
